verified_facts.text: Villa La Massa is at Via della Massa 24 in Candeli, near Florence.
The rooms are spread across the estate's six buildings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cradled within the estate’s six buildings, our rooms embody the harmony between Renaissance beauty and contemporary comfort

verified_facts.text: The suites have views of the Arno and the Chianti hills, a short distance from the heart of Florence.
verified_facts.excerpt: With generous living rooms and views of the Arno and the Chianti hills, every stay becomes a serene and authentic Tuscan experience, just moments from the heart of Florence.

verified_facts.text: The Suite Colonica suites are in the 19th-century Casa Colonica farmhouse, with Santafiora stone, terracotta and jasmine-scented courtyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the 19th-century Casa Colonica farmhouse, these suites celebrate rural Tuscany through a modern lens. Wood, terracotta, Santafiora stone and vibrant textiles

verified_facts.text: Junior Suites Top in Villa Nobile, Il Villino and Il Mulino use 16th-century damask and fabrics made by artisans of nearby Rovezzano.
verified_facts.excerpt: 16th-century damask and fine fabrics crafted by the artisans of nearby Rovezzano, a historic cradle of textile tradition

verified_facts.text: Prestige Rooms in Villa Nobile and Il Mulino have wood panelling, canopy beds, linen wall coverings and either frescoed ceilings or exposed beams.
verified_facts.excerpt: they feature wood panelling, canopy beds, linen wall coverings, and either frescoed ceilings or exposed beams

verified_facts.text: Exclusive Rooms in La Limonaia have private gardens on the ground floor and terraces over the Arno on the upper level.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the ground floor, large windows open onto delightful private gardens; on the upper level, terraces overlook the River Arno.

verified_facts.text: The Arno Suite in Il Villino has a private garden, a lounge with fireplace and a panoramic terrace above the Arno.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expansive windows open onto a private garden and the river beyond, while the cosy lounge with fireplace and the panoramic terrace above the Arno

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has two bedrooms, a lounge with a fireplace and a private riverside terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Presidential Suite offers two expansive bedrooms, refined marble bathrooms, and a welcoming lounge where convivial moments are shared beside the fireplace. Outside, a private riverside terrace

verified_facts.text: The Parco Suite has two bedrooms and two marble bathrooms and sleeps up to four guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: the suite features two spacious bedrooms, two majestic marble bathrooms and a cosy living room

verified_facts.text: Il Verrocchio serves Italian and Tuscan traditional cuisine made with local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its cuisine is a homage to Italian and Tuscan tradition, reinterpreted with elegance: local ingredients give life to dishes

verified_facts.text: L'Oliveto is a poolside bistro in a former stone hay barn.
verified_facts.excerpt: L’Oliveto welcomes guests to a former stone hay barn, now transformed into an elegant and intimate poolside bistro

verified_facts.text: Bar Mediceo is in the Villa Nobile.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the serene heart of the Villa Nobile, Bar Mediceo is much more than a historic salon

verified_facts.text: Dining is offered on a terrace overlooking the River Arno, by the pool or in a frescoed salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether on the terrace overlooking the River Arno, by the pool, or in a frescoed salon

verified_facts.text: The restaurants and bar are open from April to November.
Culinary experiences include a cocktail class, wine tastings and a cooking class.
The executive chef is Stefano Ballarino.
Villa La Massa also has villas and apartments.
verified_facts.excerpt: the villas and apartments at Villa La Massa combine the warmth of a private home

subjective.text: Rooms are described as a quiet retreat where time slows.
